label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: The cookie banner buttons come last in focus order after the page loads, and a country dialog grabbed focus first; I had to tab through the whole page footer and drawer to find Reject Non-Essential
Several links in the hero and category area have no name at all, so I could not tell where they lead
Reaching any product by keyboard takes about 20 Tab presses past the header, and the skip link only moves a few elements ahead
Each product card exposes its size options as separate links with very long all-caps labels, and the product name itself is not a clear link; I opened the product through an XS size link

element.name: XS SELECT SIZE EXTRA SMALL FOR AIRPLANE WIDE LEG PANT

findings.problem: Seven identical View larger images buttons with no distinguishing names come before the colour and size choices, and every colour and size radio is its own Tab stop, so the Add to Bag button took about 25 Tab presses to reach

The checkout page showed almost nothing to read at first; focus landed in a language selector inside an embedded frame, followed by Apple Pay, PayPal and Google Pay buttons before the first contact field, and no email field came before First name
After Add to Bag the cart drawer opened but focus stayed on a heading text, and the Checkout link came after quantity box, plus, Remove and View Bag, so it took six Tab presses to reach it
